name: Macquarie Data Centres IC3 Super West

address.note: Lot 527 DP 752035 (EIS); SSD-24299707 site, City of Ryde LGA

postcode.note: development consent / SoR list the address as Macquarie Park; postcode 2113 per EIS title block

lat.note: geocoded: address point for 17-23 Talavera Road (campus-level; not building-specific)

builder.note: main building contractor, appointed Jun 2024; 7th FDC project for Macquarie DC

mw_it.note: operator marketing; phase 1 fits out 6MW IT. Earlier (2021-2024) figures: 32MW IT (campus to 50MW), later campus 63-65MW

mw_grid.note: DPE assessment report Table 1: power consumption 38 MW; site total 28 MW -> 66 MW (Table 2). Original EIS (Nov 2021) stated +33 MW (28 -> 61 MW) before amendment

cost_aud_m.note: CIV $332,032,973 (DPE assessment report Table 1, amended application; IPC SoR: 'investment of over $332 million'). Original EIS (8 Nov 2021) CIV $289,731,682. Earlier value $504.1m ('EDC $504,111,490') came from a search snippet and was not found in the EIS or assessment report - dropped. Operator cites ~AUD 350m for phase 1 (core/shell + 6MW fit-out)

authority.note: consent authority because City of Ryde objected and a company connected to the applicant disclosed a reportable political donation (IPC SoR)

pathway.note: SSD under s4.36 EP&A Act: data centre >10 MW (cl 25 Sch 1, former SRD SEPP)

lodged.note: 'the SSD application was lodged on 12 November 2021' (assessment report); exhibited 18 Nov - 15 Dec 2021; amended application later lodged under cl 55AA

determined.note: approved with conditions by IPC (Ms Juliet Grant, Dr Bronwyn Evans AM); SoR and consent dated 19 Jan 2024

jobs_construction.note: assessment report Table 1 'Employment: 610 construction jobs and 20 additional operational jobs'; IPC SoR: 'would generate approximately 610 construction jobs'. No definition (peak/FTE) given

jobs_construction_other.note: assessment report (traffic, preliminary CTMP): 'a maximum of 150 workers on-site at any given time'
original EIS (Nov 2021): 'approximately 1,200 construction jobs for the new purpose-built data centre' (previously attributed to an applicant statement to the IPC - corrected)
operator 2025: '2,400 construction, design and fit-out jobs'

jobs_operational.note: assessment report: 'up to 20 additional knowledge-intensive operational jobs'; Table 2 staff: existing 29 + 20 = 49

jobs_operational_other.note: EIS: 'a total of approximately 49 operational jobs for the consolidated facility' (whole campus, incl. 29 existing); same total in assessment report Table 2

construction_start.note: construction start announced with FDC appointment, Jun 2024

construction_end.note: expected: operator page (fetched 2026-09-27) still says 'currently under construction ... ready for service in 2026' and lists IC3 Super West as 'Coming Soon'; press says opening Sep 2026; topped out 2 Dec 2025; building construction reported complete in 2026 (Capital Brief). DPE-assessed programme: 6+3+6+9 months

open_questions: status: operator page (2026-09-27) still shows 'Coming Soon'/under construction with RFS 2026; opening (first 6MW, Sep 2026) not yet confirmed
jobs: 610 (DPE/IPC, undefined basis) vs 1,200 (EIS/operator) vs 2,400 (operator 2025) construction figures are different measures; only the 150 peak on-site figure is defined
